# AND requires both sides
plan = 'pro' AND active = TRUE

# OR accepts either side
plan = 'pro' OR plan = 'team'

# AND binds more tightly than OR
plan = 'free' OR plan = 'pro' AND active = TRUE

# Parentheses override precedence
(plan = 'free' OR plan = 'pro') AND active = TRUE

# Two groups joined by AND
(country = 'Japan' OR country = 'Brazil') AND (age < 35 OR balance > 2000)

# A chain of ANDs
age > 20 AND age < 50 AND plan != 'free'

# Neither TRUE nor FALSE: only NULL rows are left
active != TRUE AND active != FALSE

# Keywords are case-insensitive
plan = 'team' and age > 50 or name = 'Mo Reyes'

# The scope still hides the soft-deleted Nora behind an OR
name = 'Nora Quinn' OR plan = 'pro'

# Redundant parentheses
((age > 60))

# A joined field and a lateral field in one filter
country = 'Japan' AND order_count > 0

# OR across a NULL test and a comparison
age > 60 OR country = NULL
